clue.text: Kind of shrink underwear giving revealing glimpse!

parts.note: a shrink is a psychiatrist, and one of Sigmund Freud's school is a Freudian
a slip is a woman's undergarment, a petticoat

explanation.surface: A risqué image of a psychiatrist's underclothes giving onlookers an eyeful.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a slightly loose description: the slip of the tongue reveals a glimpse of hidden thoughts.
explanation.definitionFit: A verbal error thought to expose unconscious desires offers a revealing peek into the speaker's mind.

clue.text: Bass player?

parts.note: reads as a musician on a bass guitar, but bass is also a fish, and a player with fish is an angler

explanation.surface: A musician on the low strings of a band.
explanation.definitionFit: Bass is a sea fish, so someone who goes after it with rod and line is an angler of sorts.

clue.text: Former Queen guitarist finally producing strain

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the usual crossword abbreviation for Queen

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word guitarist

explanation.surface: An ex-member of the rock band Queen on guitar ends up putting in the effort.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests the band Queen and its guitarist; Queen is really ER.
explanation.definitionFit: To strain is to make an effort with force, a synonym for applying oneself hard.

clue.text: The German and French held in check

indicators.note: held means one piece is gripped inside the other here

parts.note: der is a German word for the
et is French for and

explanation.surface: German and French forces were contained and kept in check.
explanation.definitionFit: To check someone is to restrain or discourage them, a synonym in its verb sense.

clue.text: 'Bounty' sailor on a foreign trip, perhaps

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a standard abbreviation for sailor
un is a in French, a foreign language
to trip is to dance lightly, as in trip the light fantastic

explanation.surface: A crewman of HMS Bounty on a voyage abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: The quote marks make Bounty look like the famous mutiny ship; it is just the word meaning plenty.
explanation.definitionFit: Bounty means a generous plentiful supply, a synonym for great plenty.

clue.text: Red, therefore put on US agency file

parts.note: so means therefore
CIA is the US Central Intelligence Agency
a file is a row or line, as is a list

explanation.surface: A communist, so the American spy agency opens a dossier on him.
explanation.definitionFit: Red is a common informal term for a left-winger or communist.

clue.text: Bury or Milan football team

definitions.meaning: ... Milan is one of the city's two big football clubs

explanation.definitionFit: Inter means to bury, and Internazionale, known as Inter, is a Milan football club.

clue.text: An iron drive I smashed producing 'plonk'

indicators.note: smashed means broken up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A golfer hits an iron and smashes the drive, ending up with a cheap drink.
explanation.walkthrough: Iron and drive suggest golf; Bury earlier in the puzzle is also an English football town.
explanation.definitionFit: Plonk is British slang for cheap wine, which the French phrase for ordinary table wine describes.

clue.text: Publish paper with no leader

indicators.note: with no leader means the first letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: tissue is a thin kind of paper

explanation.surface: Bring out a newspaper that has no editorial at the front.
explanation.walkthrough: Leader suggests a newspaper's editorial; it means only the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue a book or statement is to publish or release it.

clue.text: Open out cutter and cut

indicators.note: open out suggests the letters are spread out and rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions to unfold a cutting tool and slice.
explanation.definitionFit: Truncated means shortened by having a part chopped off, so cut.

clue.text: Girl's someone thankless about the heartless break up

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, with the 's giving S

indicators.note: about means the thankless person goes round the shortened word

parts.note: an ingrate is an ungrateful person

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter is removed

explanation.surface: A girl's ungrateful lover sees the heartless one fall apart.
explanation.definitionFit: To disintegrate is to fall to pieces, to break up.

clue.text: Drained and dead after unconcealed passion

indicators.note: after means the abbreviation for dead follows the other pieces

parts.note: overt means open, not hidden
ire is anger, a strong passion
D is an abbreviation for dead, as on family trees

explanation.surface: Exhausted and lifeless after a bout of open passion.
explanation.definitionFit: Drained means utterly exhausted, which is to be overtired.

clue.text: Lands winning serves holding head of racket

indicators.note: holding means the serves contain the next piece

parts.note: aces are tennis serves that win the point outright

indicators.note: head of points to the first letter of racket

explanation.surface: A tennis player lands winning serves with the top of the racket.
explanation.walkthrough: Lands looks like a verb in the tennis picture; it is the noun, plots of land.
explanation.definitionFit: Acres are areas of land, so a plural noun meaning lands or estates.

clue.text: Eternal punishment from mother country

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal
a nation is a country

explanation.surface: A mother country sentencing someone to perpetual punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: Theologically, condemnation to hell for ever is eternal punishment.

clue.text: Like a record, in a sense

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in means the first a and the record go inside the sense

parts.note: nous is common sense
taken as written
a log is a written record

explanation.surface: A remark that something is like a record, in a manner of speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: The comma tempts a split after 'record', but 'in a sense' is the container: 'in' puts the opening phrase inside the sense, with the second 'a' in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Analogous means comparable or similar, so like in its adjective sense.

clue.text: Meddling isn't in our diverse characters

indicators.note: diverse means varied, so the letters are put in a different order

explanation.surface: A protest that meddling is not part of our varied character.
explanation.definitionFit: An intrusion is an unwelcome interference, which is meddling.

clue.text: Enclosed by container of dead people

parts.note: in means enclosed or inside
a can is a metal container

explanation.surface: Sealed inside a box holding human remains.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition refers to the Incas, the long-vanished people of Peru.
explanation.definitionFit: Incan describes the Inca civilisation, whose people are long dead.

clue.text: Motor endlessly with spirit riding rented car

indicators.note: riding means sitting above the next piece in this down entry
endlessly means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a motor is a car
brio is spirit or verve
let means rented out

explanation.surface: Driving a hired car with zest.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabriolet is a car with a folding roof, a convertible.

clue.text: Assassin in Japan catching assassin

indicators.note: catching means the answer is held within the run of words

explanation.surface: One killer in Japan catching another killer.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer sits inside the first three words, and the final word is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A ninja was a covert Japanese agent trained in espionage and killing.

clue.text: Outside of tuber, fit for consumption, not deadly

indicators.note: outside of means the first and last letters of tuber

parts.note: eatable means fit to be eaten

explanation.surface: A tuber whose skin is edible and not poisonous.
explanation.definitionFit: Treatable describes a condition that can be cured, hence not fatal.

clue.text: One had a house somewhere in America

parts.note: I'd is a contraction of I had, and I is one

explanation.surface: Someone owned a home somewhere in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Idaho is a state in the north-western United States.

clue.text: Can't stand a pain not ending, taking heroin

indicators.note: taking means the shortened word takes in the drug
not ending means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a bore, a tiresome person, is a pain
H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: Someone who loathes a tedious person who never stops and is on drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: To abhor something is to detest it, to be unable to bear it.

clue.text: Terribly thin pauper losing time is more depressed

indicators.note: terribly suggests something badly wrought, so the letters are mixed
losing means the letter for time goes

explanation.surface: A dreadfully skinny poor man who has lost his time is gloomier.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove T from THIN, then rearrange HIN with PAUPER. The definition is 'more depressed'; 'is' links.
explanation.definitionFit: Unhappier is the comparative of unhappy, meaning sadder or more down.

clue.text: Initially heard in New Delhi, Indian language

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A tongue first heard spoken in New Delhi.
explanation.definitionFit: Hindi is the most widely spoken language of northern India.

clue.text: Quietly got up to give speech

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
rose means got up or stood

explanation.surface: Someone stood up softly to deliver an address.
explanation.definitionFit: Prose is ordinary language without metre, as in everyday speech.

clue.text: National Thai Open I broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Thai Open golf tournament being televised.
explanation.definitionFit: An Ethiopian is a national, or citizen, of Ethiopia.

clue.text: A little hooter?

parts.note: a hooter is a car horn or nose, but also an owl, and a little one is a young owl

explanation.surface: A small nose or a small horn.
explanation.definitionFit: A young owl, a bird that hoots, is a little hooter.

clue.text: Feeling tender before guys covered in sex appeal

indicators.note: before means the offer comes ahead of the rest

parts.note: to tender is to present or offer

indicators.note: covered in means the guys are wrapped inside the sex appeal

parts.note: it is old slang for sex appeal
men are guys

explanation.surface: A tender feeling in front of attractive men.
explanation.definitionFit: A presentiment is an intuitive feeling that something is about to happen.
